summary: ZCode grants new users who connect a BigModel account a no-payment trial: 8 million tokens per day for the first 5 days (GLM-5.4 3M/day + GLM-5.3-Flash 5M/day). The daily quota refreshes during those 5 days and then expires — it is not an ongoing free tier. Intended for trying ZCode Agent before a GLM Coding Plan. The same docs say Z.ai (overseas) new users also get a free daily trial quota for flagship GLM models, but the 8M/5-day split is quoted only in the BigModel section. Distinct from Z.ai's ongoing Flash free APIs and the Z.ai Startups Program.
claim_steps: Install/open ZCode and connect a BigModel account (welcome screen Continue with BigModel, or Settings → Model Settings).
New users receive the 5-day trial automatically with no payment; check remaining daily quota on the BigModel provider page.
After day 5 the trial quota expires; subscribe to a GLM Coding Plan (Lite/Pro/Max) in-app if you need more.

social_proof.title: Connect Models | ZCode Docs
social_proof.text: According to the Upgrade Plan page, the Start Plan lasts 5 days and provides 8 million tokens per day for GLM models: | GLM-5.4 | 3 million tokens / day | | GLM-5.3-Flash | 5 million tokens / day | Note: the trial lasts 5 days only and expires afterwards — it is not an ongoing daily allowance.
